LapRecord.title: LapRecord
LapRecord.description: Fastest single-lap record submitted by an authenticated driver for a specific circuit.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the driver who set this record.

driverName.description: Public racing display name shown on the leaderboard.

trackId.description: Identifier of the circuit where the lap was recorded.

chassisId.description: Low-poly car chassis model used for the lap.

paintFinish.description: PBR paint material finish on the car.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this record was created or improved.

DailyChallengeProgress.title: DailyChallengeProgress
DailyChallengeProgress.description: Authenticated driver's daily challenge streak and unlocked unique livery colors.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the driver.

totalCompleted.description: Cumulative number of daily challenges completed.

lastCompletedDate.description: Most recent UTC challenge date completed in YYYY-MM-DD format.

unlockedLiveryIds.description: Unique daily reward livery IDs unlocked by the player (1..8 items).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when streak progress was last updated.

/lapRecords/{recordId}.description: Global per-track personal best lap times keyed by {uid}_{trackId}.

/dailyChallenges/{userId}.description: Owner-only daily challenge streak state and unlocked reward liveries.
